## Background

I'm currently pursuing the Master of Data Science program at the University of British Columbia. I grew up and studied in India, and graduated in July 2024 with a B.Tech in Computer Science, specializing in Data Science, from Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune. Before that I interned at C-DOT in Delhi, working on deep-learning-based biometric face recognition and a multimodal disaster-management dashboard, and spent time as a data engineering researcher on the KG4ASTRA extension programme, building ontology and hierarchy graphs in Neo4j for missile classification NLP models.

From September 2024 I was a Data Scientist at **Fractal Analytics** in Bangalore, working across several client engagements:

- **Behavioural Data Science (BHP Australia)** — GenAI-driven safety risk modeling and cognitive/behavioral analytics using neuroscience inputs.
- **Order Automation (Carrier, AWS GenAI)** — vision-language models (AWS Nova, Claude, Mistral) for PDF ingestion and RAG-based document understanding.
- **Agentic AI Systems (Molina Healthcare)** — LLM-based agents and orchestration layers, tuned for latency and compute efficiency.
- **Multi-Agent Workflows (Cogentiq AI)** — claim validation with LangGraph and CrewAI, built around prompt-engineered LLM pipelines.
- **Customer Service Automation (Flyfish AI)** — RAG pipelines over ChromaDB and Elasticsearch, tuned for production use.

## What I work with

**Languages:** Python, R, SQL
**ML / Deep Learning:** TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, scikit-learn, OpenCV
**GenAI:** GPT, Claude, LangChain, RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, prompt engineering, LLMOps
**Cloud & tooling:** AWS, Docker, Git, GitLab
**Data:** MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Neo4j
**Visualization:** Power BI, Tableau

A few projects I've enjoyed building: an ML model classifying [hazardous asteroids](https://github.com/harshil2sharma/Applying-Machine-Learning-Principles-to-Categorize-Asteroids-as-Hazardous-or-Non-Hazardous) from NASA/JPL data, [Kitna Kharcha](https://github.com/harshil2sharma/Kitna-Kharcha) — a location-aware urban financial planning tool, and [SneakerXchange](https://github.com/harshil2sharma/SneakerXchange), an HCI-driven reselling platform prototype accepted for presentation at ICICC 2026 (Springer, top 15% of submissions).

## Outside of data science

When I'm away from a notebook, I'm usually running or cycling — training for the next race is a nice antidote to a week of debugging pipelines. I bake and cook more than is strictly reasonable, and I've picked up a handful of wins over the years in general knowledge, art, and dance competitions.

You can find more of my work on [GitHub](https://github.com/harshil2sharma) or connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harshil-sharma-002ms2012/).
